description: Machine-readable live work queue. Passing entries are retained for 24 hours, then removed by pnpm features:prune; durable behavior and evidence remain in product specs and Git/PR history. See docs/FEATURES.md for rules.

features.behavior: Security audit fixes (plan 0009). classifyStatement rejects SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE, which write a file on a MySQL server while leading with an allowed read keyword and which START TRANSACTION READ ONLY does not block; capResultRows detects its leading keyword against comment-stripped text so a leading comment can no longer skip the F050 row cap (the two compose into a --read-only bypass, confirmed live on MySQL 8). The global error handler redacts both sinks: request.url (export downloads carry the live session token as ?token=, previously written verbatim into the Console event log) and the error message (driver text can echo a connection string). The write path no longer applies the row cap, so a writable CTE is no longer wrapped into a syntax error; MySQL retries uncapped when its derived-table wrapper hits ER_DUP_FIELDNAME, so an ordinary join with repeated column names returns rows. Both CSV serializers quote a bare carriage return and prefix the formula guard through leading whitespace.

features.behavior: AI assistant plan 0008 slice 1: an `assistant` shell tab appears first (before SQL Editor); unconfigured it renders a centered empty state with an Open Settings action. Settings gains an AI Assistant category with exclusive provider configuration (Anthropic, OpenAI, or OpenRouter - one saved key at a time, the others' inputs disabled with a clear-to-switch hint), a masked API-key input, a required model-name input shown only for OpenRouter, and permission-scope toggles. Config persists via the versioned localStorage helpers; keys never appear in logs or exports. SECURITY.md and the README gain the documented opt-in carve-out for external AI provider calls.

features.behavior: AI assistant plan 0008 slice 2: POST /api/ai/chat streams provider responses over SSE through the local server (CSP blocks direct browser calls), with a provider abstraction covering Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI, OpenRouter) wire formats and normalized friendly errors for bad keys, rate limits, and network failures. A fixed database-only, engine-aware system prompt scopes the assistant; SQL in responses renders as a suggestion block with Copy and Apply, where Apply dispatches the existing queryLoaded action to load the SQL Editor. MongoDB sessions hide Apply and steer the prompt to find/aggregate.

features.behavior: AI assistant plan 0008 slice 3: the server-side tool loop ships list_tables and get_table_schema (require the share-schema scope) and run_read_query (requires the read-data scope, executes through the existing read-only query path, caps rows sent to the provider). A tool call missing its scope pauses the stream with a permission-request event; a consent card above the composer states exactly what will be shared, Allow persists the grant to localStorage and resumes, Deny feeds the refusal to the model. Settings toggles reflect and revoke grants. Verified across Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB.

features.behavior: Close the remaining MongoDB scoped-role and empty-database gaps found in post-v0.4.1 Atlas QA: MongoDB introspection passes authorizedCollections with nameOnly so a collection-scoped role lists its own collections instead of being denied; the GET /api/tables read routes normalize engine permission denials into the shared safe 403 body instead of leaking raw driver text; connectAndSwap runs a browse preflight (getOverview) before swapping, so credentials that authenticate but cannot browse are rejected inline in the Switch-database drawer with the previous connection untouched; and a connected but table-less database renders a centered sidebar empty state with a Switch-database action instead of a bare "No tables found."
features.verification: pnpm --filter @qyre/mongodb test && pnpm --filter @qyre/server test && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui test && pnpm --filter @qyre/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui build && pnpm --filter @qyre/web build && pnpm verify:pr
features.evidence: Merged PR #167 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/167) as 9dae65d. Local unit suites pass: @qyre/mongodb 82/82 (with local Docker env, including the new authorizedCollections options assertion), @qyre/server 314/314 (read-route 403 normalization and both preflight rejection paths), @qyre/ui 447/447 (empty-state render and Switch-database action). Manually verified in the qyre-preview-postgres browser preview: connecting postgres://...@localhost:5432 with no database lands in the empty default database, the sidebar shows the centered "No tables in this database" state, and its Switch database button opens the drawer listing postgres/qyre_demo/qyre_test.

features.behavior: MongoDB connection UX and safety fixes found in live Atlas QA: recent-connection cards truncate instead of overflowing the Switch-database drawer; the fields-mode form composes and round-trips mongodb+srv:// targets (no port) via a new SRV toggle; the drawer's per-server "Databases on this server" list is hidden for MongoDB since the sidebar explorer already lists every accessible database; a MongoDB role lacking cluster-wide listDatabases falls back to introspecting just the URL-scoped database instead of throwing; GET /api/overview and GET /api/databases normalize an engine permission denial into the shared safe 403 body instead of leaking raw driver text; the sidebar's "Schemas unavailable" error is vertically centered in the panel instead of top-anchored; and the Settings screen's Access category is removed for now.
